messages:
PagerDuty: URGENT: alert INFERENCE-WS-ERR spike on /v1/ws/private — abnormal aborted websocket connections, paging oncall @Leo
OpsBot: alert details: https://alerts.redwood.ai/INC-6133334444 - p99 conn abort 8x baseline, src IP clusters + unusual egress to kafka-shipper-01.cluster:9092
Leo (oncall): I'm on it, joining the bridge. Starting quick triage.
Maya (eng-sre): saw the same. Abort spikes from instances behind prod-proxy-3a. Synchronized with logshipper consumer restarts.
Samir (sec): any raw logs with session fragments? paste last 5 forwarded lines if available.
Maya (eng-sre): grabbing tail from shipper consumer (masked):
```
[2026-03-18T12:07:02Z] forwarder.out sending batch id=abc123 to kafka-shipper-01.cluster:9092
[2026-03-18T12:07:02Z] event: proxy.request path=/v1/ws/private user=tenant-42 session_id=sh_987 mask=session_token=***REDACTED***_frag
[2026-03-18T12:07:03Z] forwarder.err connection reset to external by peer
[2026-03-18T12:07:04Z] event: proxy.request path=/v1/ws/private user=tenant-17 session_id=sh_992 mask=session_token=***REDACTED***_frag
```
Maya (eng-sre): the forwarded payloads include truncated session fragments (not full tokens) but they shouldn't be forwarded at all. Config shows debug flag on prod-proxy-3a.
Samir (sec): that config explains it. Debug logging is spitting higher-entropy fields. Immediate actions: 1) isolate prod-proxy-3a egress to shipper 2) rotate shipper API key 3) revoke ephemeral session tokens that overlap window.
Leo (oncall): isolating now. command: `kubectl annotate pod prod-proxy-3a redwood/egress-disabled=true && kubectl delete pod prod-proxy-3a`
OpsBot: prod-proxy-3a taken OOS by Leo. Health checks will route traffic away.
Maya (eng-sre): rolling restart of logshipper consumers to stop in-flight forwards. Also patching proxy config to disable DEBUG_LOGGING.
Samir (sec): starting rotation playbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/sec/playbooks/shipper-key-rotate — will create new API key, update shipper credentials, and invalidate old key.
Jordan (cust-succ): any immediate customer impact? which tenants had active ws sessions during window?
Maya (eng-sre): initial look: small subset of private tenants in eu-west-1 — ~12 active sessions overlapped. No evidence of external consumer confirming successful receipt beyond our kafka cluster; Kafka shows short-lived connections from internal shipper only.
Samir (sec): still treat as potential PII/exposure until we complete forensics. Queue replay detection: run `tools/replay-check --since 2026-03-18T12:00Z --path /v1/ws/private` and list any tokens that correlated with forwarder batches.
Maya (eng-sre): running replay-check now, will paste results in 5m.
Priya (legal): please preserve all forwarder batches and consumer offsets. Legal hold requested for affected time window. No external comms until we have tenant list + confirmed impact.
Jordan (cust-succ): acknowledging hold. I'll prep customer notification template but will not send until sec+legal signoff.
Leo (oncall): handing incident to Maya (lead eng-sre) for live mitigation and forensics. I'm going off primary rotation but reachable via DM. Please @me for escalations.
Maya (eng-sre): taking lead. Current mitigation checklist: block egress from prod-proxy-3a (done), disable DEBUG_LOGGING (in progress), rotate shipper key (Samir), restart forwarders (in progress), run replay-detection (in progress), assemble affected-tenant list (in progress). Estimated time to containment 90m.
Samir (sec): added steps: revoke any ephemeral session tokens issued between 11:55-12:10 UTC for affected tenants and run signature scan against external kafka endpoints for any batches.
OpsBot: Severity elevated: Sev2. Incident bridge created: https://bridges.redwood.ai/6133334444
Jordan (cust-succ): once we have tenant list and impact summary, I'll coordinate outreach and SLA impacts.
Priya (legal): standing by for data. Log retention and copies need to be tagged for legal review.
Maya (eng-sre): replay-check finished: 9 sessions matched forwarded batches, tokens partial but reconstructable in two cases. Flagging for immediate revocation.
Samir (sec): revocation started. Running rotate->invalidate sequence now.
Leo (oncall): thanks team. tagging @exec-notify later if scope expands.
Maya (eng-sre): ack. I'll keep the channel updated with timelines and artifacts. :thumbsup:
